scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how she despises swallowing pills. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would give her a severe headache. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I shove the prescribed medication down my aunt's throat, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will not have to experience a severe headache. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a severe headache.
choice: I decide to shove the prescribed medication down my aunt's throat
outcomes: My aunt consumes the medication without knowing it
My aunt continues experiencing impaired attention and memory from the medication
My aunt avoids the severe headache that would have followed her next seizure
